searchText: Under current proposals transactions will NOT include the eth2 fork id and will continue working exactly like they do now with an unchanging chain ID. At least as far as I understand things. Hmm, that is unfortunate. what is the current timeline for the implementation? It is already implemented in several clients. Undergoing testing now. sounds amazing For the merge? As I understand it there is a PoC with forks of Teku and Geth. I’m not aware of any other clients that currently have anything working. For EIP1559 which is actually in topic here, Micah‘s statement is accurate. 🙂 <@!552133098075193354> we started syncing but it has been going slowly over the first blocks, we will look what is happening there (the blocks are 2 billion gas but still they seem to go slowly)
